Maya: quick drop 
RN draft for the maintenance push. Requesting pin for model-server v2.3.1-slimpin and a short stage-gate at 15:40 PT. Who can own pin + deploy? :rocket:
Victor: I can take the pin and trigger. Please label pin `v2.3.1-slimpin-2024-06` so the release board picks it up.
Ruth: RN note suggestion: 'Reduces background GC pauses for long-context workloads. Watch tokenization edge-case Y; fallback to v2.3.0 if errors.' Keep internal blurb terse.
Maya: added that copy and a rollback snippet. Also added changelog line. Preview: https://redwood.internal/rn/1723456789 (internal).
SRE Oncall: Change window reserved 15:30-16:30. I'll set an alert: error-rate >= 1% for 4m or p95 > 350ms => notify #incident-deploy and page.
deploy-bot: queued deploy job 87345 | env=prod-dedicated | image=model-server:v2.3.1-slimpin | strategy=canary(5%,6m)->30%(10m)->100% | requested_by=Victor | pin_label=v2.3.1-slimpin-2024-06
Victor: dry-run at 15:35: ```deploybot trigger 87345 --dry-run``` If dry-run passes I'll post internal announce and start at 15:40.
Ruth: recommend KV-cache warmup for 30s prior to canary and include a short smoke test script in RN. Also add quick rollback checklist (flip flag + revert image).
Maya: done. RN now has warmup steps + smoke script snippet.
deploy-bot: job 87345 status: dry-run passed at 15:36. Ready for scheduled rollout at 15:40.
Victor: posting internal announce at 15:38: "Deploying model-server v2.3.1-slimpin at 15:40 PT. Canary rollout. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Victor @Maya." :thumbsup:
Maya: please pin the RN to #eng-releases after announce and update CHANGELOG with the exact pin label.
Victor: starting timed rollout.
deploy-bot: job 87345 status: canary(5%) started at 15:40.
Ruth: watching metrics; initial 2m looks fine, warmup completed.
deploy-bot: job 87345 status: canary(30%) started at 15:46.
SRE Oncall: checks running, no sustained 5xx. p95 stable. Green to proceed to 100% in 10m unless we see regressions.
Victor: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: job 87345 status: 100% started at 15:57. job 87345 status: success at 16:02.
docs-bot: changelog updated: "model-server v2.3.1-slimpin-2024-06 - reduced GC pauses, tokenization note". Link: https://redwood.internal/changelog/87345
Maya: awesome, RN pinned and changelog entry confirmed. I'll post the finalized internal note and close this thread. :white_check_mark:
Ruth: thanks all. Closing.
